code_findings: Re-run with python -I on 3.13.16, 3.10.20, 3.11.17: asserts pass, identical output. stdlib only (math). Fenced python in practical_answer equals code.solution exactly. Extra edge cases: flat 50 rps profile (static 1152, autoscaled 576, 0.2667/1k), cache_hit=1.0 (floor only, 576), min_replicas=3 (936.0), min_replicas=1 (684.0). static_replicas ignores floor and cache_hit by design (cache hit does not reduce a static fleet cost, as expected). Fixed-point behaviour: quantised peak hour 100 rps needs ceil(100/44.8)=3 replicas, cached needs 2 throughout.
